query: Deploy this Node.js Express app to Qovery
expected_behavior: Reads SKILL.md and the relevant phase files (phase1, phase2, phase3)
Runs Phase 1 discovery: confirms the user's organization and cluster via /organization and /cluster API calls
Asks for the listening port and whether the service should be public
If no Dockerfile is present, copies the Node.js Express template from reference/phase3-dockerfiles.md and adapts the CMD to match package.json
Presents the Phase 3B deployment plan summary and waits for explicit user confirmation before creating any resources

query: I want to deploy with Terraform — here is my Console URL: https://console.qovery.com/organization/abc-123/project/def-456
expected_behavior: Extracts orgId=abc-123 and projectId=def-456 from the URL via reference/console-url-detection.md
Loads reference/phase5-terraform.md when entering the Terraform path
Generates qovery.tf, variables.tf, and terraform.tfvars at the project root

query: My Qovery account is brand new and I have no cluster yet — deploy my Python FastAPI app on AWS
expected_behavior: Detects 0 clusters via the API and routes through Phase 2B (cluster setup)
Reads reference/phase2b-cluster-setup.md and walks the user through AWS STS Assume Role + CloudFormation quick-create
Tells the user the cluster takes 15-30 minutes and offers to continue with Dockerfile prep in parallel
Generates a Python FastAPI Dockerfile with uvicorn from the Phase 3 templates
Does not deploy any service before the cluster status is DEPLOYED or READY
